findings.question: rc-cs-nsd-0013
findings.quote: This borrows the leading number of the grant amount. Three million funds a facility. Check the scale and purpose of the amount.
findings.problem: The note does not correctly explain the 300-peso choice: the grant amount is three million pesos, whose leading number is 3, not 300. It gives no valid reason that 300 would look right.
findings.fix: Use "3 pesos" as the distractor and explain that it copies the grant's number while dropping "million" and confusing a facility grant with a per-kilogram price.

findings.question: q-comprehension-skills-noting-specific-details-0016
findings.quote: This selects the old location. Both rooms are described together. Check the phrase after the move.
findings.problem: The choice says "Beside the library's old reading room," but the passage places visitors in the old reading room beside the library. A place beside that room is not the room itself, so the note incorrectly says this choice selects the old location.
findings.fix: Explain that the choice misreads the location beside the library as a location beside the reading room and also overlooks the move; ask readers to check the new entrance location.
